Quick Facts for Sourcing

Use the Complete Catalog Row for Sourcing

A rim diameter alone does not identify a cup. Compare the full model row — caliber, capacity, dimensions, weight and carton quantity — then request the final drawing and a matched lid sample. Printing, exact lid fit, production tolerance and destination-market documents are pending factory confirmation for the selected model.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which PET calibers appear in the latest catalog?

The latest PET catalog shows 90, 92, 95, 98, 107 and 117mm series. The visible listed capacities range from 200ml to 1,000ml. Confirm the exact model, drawing and lid before ordering.

Are the catalog PET cups suitable for hot drinks?

The supplied PET catalog does not state a verified temperature rating. Treat the cups as cold-beverage products unless the factory provides a written temperature specification for the selected model.

Is the MOQ the same for every PET model?

No single MOQ is stated across all rows in the supplied PET catalog. Confirm MOQ, printing method and carton configuration for the exact model.

How should I select a PET lid?

Start with the exact cup model and nominal rim diameter, then confirm the lid profile, closure and sealing setup with a physical cup-and-lid sample.
